# ex: assigneeType covers AssignStmt and ValueSpec paths via implicit wildcard
ex {
	var f func(int) int
	var x int
	implicit f
	f(x) -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package p

func f() {
	var x int
	x = 1
	_ = x

	var y int = 2
	_ = y
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@

 func f() {
 	var x int
-	x = 1
+	x = 1 + 1
 	_ = x

-	var y int = 2
+	var y int = 2 + 1
 	_ = y
 }
